name: WMUISkiaEffect
description: Per-pixel canvas for blend modes and blur that vector drawing cannot reach. On iOS and Android it paints through Skia. Skia on web needs the CanvasKit WASM bundle loaded by the host app, which not every host does, so web renders the same composition with CSS filter and mix-blend-mode instead and pulls in no WASM.

dataset.name: dataset
dataset.description: Blobs to draw. Each row may carry a color and a radius given as a 0-1 fraction of size. Example: [{color: '#2563EB', radius: 0.35}]

size.name: size
size.description: Canvas edge length in pixels. Default: 200

blurAmount.name: blurAmount
blurAmount.description: Gaussian blur radius applied to the blobs, in pixels. Default: 24

blendMode.name: blendMode
blendMode.description: Compositing mode used between blobs. screen gives the classic additive lava-lamp look. Default: screen

spread.name: spread
spread.description: Distance of each blob from the center, as a fraction of size. Default: 0.18

backgroundColor.name: backgroundColor
backgroundColor.description: Background painted behind the blobs. Transparent by default so the effect composites onto whatever sits below. Default: transparent
